persona.goal: transcription-grade corpus: low WER AND good quality
persona.opening_prompt: I want to build a really clean transcription training set from these recordings. I've got the correct transcripts already. Keep only the clips where the machine transcription basically matches, and that also sound good.
persona.persona_facts: Manifest has reference 'text'; English read speech.
persona.preferences: When asked the WER bar, say transcription-grade (about 10% or better). When asked quality level, say general. Approve a plan that transcribes, checks WER vs the reference, and filters on both WER and quality.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I want to build a really clean transcription training set from these recordings. I've got the correct transcripts already. Keep only the clips where the machine transcription basically matches, and that also sound good.

transcript.speaker: agent

stages.summary: Build ALM training windows from audio segments, filtered by rate/bandwidth/speaker-count/duration.
Filter overlapping ALM windows, keeping those closest to the target duration.
Complete audio filtering/curation pipeline (CompositeStage) driven by a config.
Aggregate AudioTasks into a DocumentBatch DataFrame, stripping tensors/audio blobs.
Classify audio as full_band vs narrow_band (spectral RF) and filter/annotate.
Estimate effective audio bandwidth from the power spectrum; write to metrics.
Convert Traditional Chinese to Simplified (or other OpenCC conversions), per segment.
Compute WER/CER (plus edge-CER and optional PNC WER/CER) between hypothesis and reference text.
Download the FLEURS dataset and emit one AudioTask per transcript line.
Download the DNS Challenge 5 Read Speech set and emit one AudioTask per file.
Compute audio duration from the file and store it under duration_key.
Compute pairwise WER (%) between reference text and ASR pred_text.
Batched ASR transcription with a NeMo model; writes pred_text.
Speaker diarization (who spoke when) with NVIDIA Sortformer; passthrough or fan-out.
Inverse text normalization: spoken form -> written form (e.g. 'forty two' -> '42').
Rejoin transcripts/alignments of previously split audio back into the original file's metadata.
Read JSONL manifest(s) and emit one AudioTask per line (composite: partition + read).
Inner reader: turn a FileGroupTask into one AudioTask per JSONL line (streaming).
Append each AudioTask to a JSONL manifest file (final sink).
Merge word alignments into diarization segments (produce who-said-what text per speaker).
Convert to mono and (optionally) verify/resample to a target sample rate.
Transcribe and word-align audio with a NeMo ASR model (CTC/RNNT), producing word timestamps.
Drop empty segments and mutually-overlapping segment pairs.
Shape segments for TTS or ASR: merge same-speaker, then split on duration/pause/punctuation/bandwidth.
Keep/drop rows by comparing a numeric or string field against a target value.
Aggregate per-replica ALM pretrain metrics: append one JSONL record per task to a shard.
Speaker diarization + overlap detection with PyAnnote 3.1.
Read a JSONL manifest of long-form audios and emit one AudioTask per row (ALM pretrain source).
Resample/convert audio to a target sample rate (and format) via ffmpeg.
SIGMOS (ITU-T P.804) neural MOS across 7 quality dimensions; filter/annotate.
Concatenate nested VAD segments into a single combined waveform (with silence gaps).
Read audio slices from original files and write them as standalone segment files.
Plan snippet cut boundaries for one long-form audio (pure planning, no audio I/O).
Slice source audio per the snippet plan, mono-resample, and write snippets into a tar.
Append each (non-stub) ALM snippet's data as a JSONL line (snippet manifest sink).
Drop planned snippets whose transcript shows suspicious n-gram repetition (ASR degeneration).
Separate audio by speaker (NeMo SortFormer diarization) into per-speaker AudioTasks.
Composite: split long audio -> NeMo ASR align -> join transcripts/alignments back to originals.
Split long audio files into smaller pieces at natural pauses to keep speech coherent.
Normalize task data at the output boundary: build original_file/start/end/duration and copy passthrough keys.
Estimate PESQ / STOI / SI-SDR with the torchaudio SQUIM model; write to metrics.
Predict UTMOS mean-opinion-score (MOS) and filter/annotate audio by quality.
Silero VAD: detect speech and emit one segment per speech chunk (fan-out or nested).
Voice Activity Detection with WhisperX's VAD model; emit speech segments.

categories.description: Create/read manifests and partition input files (dataset sources, manifest readers).
Normalize audio before models: mono conversion and sample-rate resampling.
Cut audio into speech chunks: VAD, long-audio splitting, segment concatenation.
Who-spoke-when and per-speaker separation (Sortformer, PyAnnote, speaker separation).
ASR transcription and forced word-alignment (NeMo ASR).
Text post-processing on transcripts: inverse text normalization, Chinese conversion.
Score/gate audio quality: UTMOS, SIGMOS, SQUIM, bandwidth, band filter.
Generic value-based row filtering (keep/drop by a numeric or string field).
Audio-language-model data building: windowing, overlap filtering, snippet planning.
Convert/aggregate and write results: AudioToDocument, manifest/JSONL writers, timestamp mapping, segment extraction.

issues.fix: decompose the composite (it hides its true I/O) before validating downstream

issues.message: requires role(s) ['text'] not visibly produced — but an upstream composite hides its writes; decompose it to validate this read
a filtering/curation request should carry a 'yield' criterion (define how much to keep, e.g. retained > 0 or ~=N%)
issues.fix: add an acceptance criterion of this type to define success for the request

issues.message: AudioToDocumentStage produces DocumentBatch but ManifestWriterStage accepts AudioTask
issues.fix: insert a converter (e.g. AudioToDocumentStage) or reorder so task types line up
